metadata.iwsdk-replit-template/note: This template still builds its objects procedurally in src/index.ts, so `nodes` is intentionally empty. The document exists for two reasons: iwsdk.config.json requires a `scene` entry (which is what lets dev.emulator.activation be "always" for the Replit preview), and EnvironmentSystem only applies DomeGradient/IBLGradient on the level-root entity — so the sky and image-based lighting below have to come from a loaded level. Add entries to `nodes` if you move to the declarative native scene workflow.
